title: Fix Shift Twice
description: This mod fix when player crouching so when player press a shift in game player will crouching twice instead once and this mod will fix
body:
# Fix Shift Twice

this mod fix when user press a shift player should crouching just once but it crouching twice instead just once

this mod borrows from Sneak Tweak and SneakFix
- Link for Sneak Tweak : https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sneak-tweak
- Link for SneakFix : https://modrinth.com/mod/sneakfix

this mod fix from bug that still existing in game and never get fix
- Link Bug Report : https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-159163

thanks @SJKZ1 for help
